nativeHost.message: Native host could not run. Run node bin/tether.mjs doctor from the repository root. Verify Node.js, the registered host.exe path and the installed extension ID; repair registration using the installation guide, then reload the extension.

nativeConfig.message: Native host configuration or certificate is missing or invalid. Run node bin/tether.mjs doctor from the repository root; restore the installed runtime and its matching .local configuration, then reload the extension.

nativeOrigin.message: Extension ID does not match the native host. Load extension/ from the same installed runtime as .local/native-host.json, then reload it. Do not mix copies from different installations.

nativeOffline.message: Broker is not listening. Auto mode probes periodically and restarts it; use Turn on to retry manually. Check runtime configuration if startup remains blocked.

nativeTLS.message: Broker certificate validation failed. Check the system clock and matching certificate/pin. For an expired certificate, stop Broker, back up the runtime and create a fresh installation in a new directory; update agent configuration and reload its extension. Do not disable TLS checks.

nativeAuth.message: Broker rejected the native host handshake. Confirm that Broker and host use the same runtime and .local configuration; stop the mismatched Broker and start the correct one.

nativeClosed.message: Broker connection closed. Auto mode will try to restart it on the next probe. Existing browser grants were revoked.

nativeFrame.message: Native message is invalid or exceeds 512 KiB. Update runtime and extension together; reduce the operation payload before retrying.

appDescription.message: Connect agents and scripts to your existing browser tabs with local, scoped access.

footer.message: Manage who can use your browser tabs.

autoApproval.message: Automatically approve new groups and existing tabs

autoOn.message: On: new groups and specified existing HTTP(S) tabs are approved automatically.

autoOff.message: Off: requests wait for your approval, and clients cannot enumerate tabs.

autoHint.message: Turn this off to stop future automatic grants; revoke active sessions below. Reloading restores the default: on.

attach.message: Attach to a tab you choose

accessHint.message: This client can read and control the approved page and create up to 10 task pages in a new group. HTTP(S) navigation and website actions are allowed. Revoke access below at any time.

chooseHint.message: Choose one existing HTTP or HTTPS tab.

noTabs.message: No available HTTP or HTTPS tabs.

brokerAuto.message: Automatically keep Broker available (default, about every 30 seconds)

brokerPortBusy.message: The Broker port is occupied. Check the listening program or correct the runtime port/certificate. Then click Start or re-enable automatic mode to retry.

brokerStartFailed.message: Broker could not start. Check runtime configuration, then click Start or re-enable automatic mode to retry.
